offering_description.value: Provides short-term pawn loans to consumers who pledge valuables for immediate cash. It buys used merchandise from customers and resells it to budget-conscious shoppers.

quotes.quote: In today’s economy, a growing number of consumers demand value, and EZCORP delivers. We sell an array of quality used items at budget-friendly prices. Our selection of merchandise is wide and ever-changing and includes gold, jewelry, electronics, tools, sporting goods, luxury handbags, shoes & sneakers, musical equipment and much more!

Customers rely on EZCORP for loans that are fast, convenient, and confidential. We go above and beyond to encourage responsibility and are guided by the principles of honesty, integrity, and fairness. We provide instant cash loans on items of value, including gold and diamond jewelry, electronics, computers, musical instruments, tools, video games, firearms (US only) and more. EZCORP works closely with every customer to help them get the money they need.
